“一起走吧。”夜风很轻。
她把发烫的手递出去，心也不再只为自己跳了。

Elsa Babe-163CM-L Pink AHRC009 Aihara Kumi-Let's not separate tonight!
She placed the hair clip in his palm, not daring to look at it herself.
He took it, tucking it back into her pink hair, his knuckles brushing against her pointed ear before stopping.
"Let's go together." The night breeze was gentle.
She offered him her burning hand, her heart no longer beating only for herself.
